findings.original: the factory inspectors have never tired of twitting the masters with this “last,” this “fatal hour.”
findings.rewrite: the factory inspectors have never tired of teasing the employers about this “last,” this “fatal hour.”
findings.problem: In [^11], "twitting" means taunting or reproaching; "teasing" softens the inspectors' polemic into playfulness.
findings.fix: the factory inspectors have never tired of taunting the employers with this “last,” this “fatal hour.”

notes_review: The logged calls are sound: the hypothetical speech in p040–p041 stays clearly marked as what Senior should have said, the [^10] arithmetic oddity is kept as printed, and "Hovell" is conservatively kept (it is probably Howell, but not a one-reading fix). "Apart from questions of principle" for "efforts in principle" is a reasonable, logged interpretation of an opaque translation.
summary: Fidelity is high: Senior's quotation, the petition and the factory report are near-verbatim, every figure survives, and the irony at Senior's expense is kept. Readability is good; only two word choices in [^11] weakened the employers' deceit and the inspectors' taunting.
